greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Uxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu malube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehlala phantsi ekhaya, ekhangela iimephu kunye neendlela zeenqwelo-moya kwikhompyutha yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongapheliyo, esakha ikamva lakhe ngengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukubona ngaphaya kwento ebonwa ngamehlo. Wayethanda ukucacisa ngale 'con chim airlines' yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos usikhumbuza inyaniso enzulu: 'Kuba bonke abaxhomekeke emisebenzini yomthetho bangaphantsi kwesiqalekiso… Lowo ulilungisa ngokholo uyakuphila.' Apha, uPawulos uthetha ngesitshixo esikhulula intliziyo yethu kwisithokothoko sokuzama ukulawula yonke into, kwaye usikhokelela ekubeni sithembe uThixo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, kukho umzuzu omangalisayo. Umfazi osemhlambini uthi kuYesu, 'Blessed is the womb that carried you and the breasts at which you nursed.' Ufuna ukuncoma umama kaYesu, uMariya, ngenxa yoxabiso lwakhe lokuba ngumama. Kodwa uYesu, endaweni yokuyikhaba loo nyaniso, uyandisa. Uthi: 'Rather, blessed are those who hear the word of God and observe it.' UYesu usibonisa ukuba ubudlelwane bethu naye abupheleli ekuzalweni okanye kwigazi, kodwa buqhubeka ngokuthi siphulaphule ilizwi likaThixo kwaye siphile ngokwalo. UBen wayeyazi le nto ngendlela yobuntwana bakhe. Wayengumfana owayephulaphula, owayenika, owayezama ukwenza uthando lube yinto ebonakalayo.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesithathu emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, kukho imibuzo engapheliyo enikhathazayo. Kukho iintlungu ezihlaselayo xa ungazilindelanga. Mhlawumbi ucinga ngaloo mzuzu xa wayemi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo wakhe, okanye xa wayecinga ngendlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, yayingenabuxoki. Kwaye namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthetha inyaniso enzulu kakhulu: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo enobubele ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya. 

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ekuthanda. Khumbula indlela uBen awayekuthanda ngayo, indlela awayekujonga ngayo njengomntu okhethekileyo. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe. Xa uziva usizi, khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. UYesu uthi: 'Blessed are those who hear the word of God and observe it.' Masiphile ke ngeli lizwi namhlanje, sithandane njengokuba uBen wayesithanda, kwaye sithembe ukuba uThixo uya kusikhokelela kude kube lixesha lokuba siphinde sidibane naye apho kungekho ntlungu, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngokwenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Musa ukuvumela ndohlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisisikelele, isigcine kuxolo lwayo, kwaye isikhokelele ebomini obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wokudabuka, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba elingenakuphela.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana: ISibhalo sababiyela bonke phantsi kwesono, ukuze isithembiso sinikwe abo bakholwayo ngalo ukholo kuYesu Kristu. Phambi kokuba kufike ukholo, sasilindwe phantsi komthetho, sibiyelwe de kwatyhilwa ukholo. Ngoko ke umthetho wawungumkhosi wethu kude kube sekufikeni kukaKristu, ukuze sigwetyelwe ngokholo. Kodwa ngoku ukuba kufikile ukholo, asisaphantsi komkhosi. Kuba ngalo ukholo, nonke ningabantwana bakaThixo kuKristu Yesu. Kuba bonke ababhaptizwe kuKristu nambethe uKristu. Akukho mYuda nakumGrike, akukho mkhoboka namntu ukhululekileyo, akukho ndoda namfazi; kuba nonke nimnye kuKristu Yesu. Ukuba ke ningabakaKristu, nina ke nisisizukulwana sika-Abraham, niziindlalifa ngokwesithembiso.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi iyalikhumbula idlelane layo ngonaphakade. Mhubeleni, mdumiseni, thethani ngayo yonke imisebenzi yakhe emangalisayo. Zibangeleni ngalo igama lakhe elingcwele; mazivuye iintliziyo ezifuna iNkosi! R. INkosi iyalikhumbula idlelane layo ngonaphakade. Khangelani kwiNkosi nakumandla ayo; funani ukuyikhonza ngamaxesha onke. Khumbulani imisebenzi emangalisayo ayenzileyo, imiqondiso yakhe, nezigwebo azithethileyo. R. INkosi iyalikhumbula idlelane layo ngonaphakade. Nina sizukulwana sika-Abraham, zikhonzi zakhe, nina bantwana bakaYakobi, banyuliweyo bakhe! Yiyo iNkosi, uThixo wethu; emhlabeni wonke izigwebo zakhe ziyabusa. R. INkosi iyalikhumbula idlelane layo ngonaphakade.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngelixa uYesu wayethetha, umfazi othile esihlweleni wamemeza wathi kuye, 'Unoyolo umbeleko owakuthwalayo nebele owancancayo.' Waphendula wathi, 'Kunoko, banoyolo abo baliphulaphulayo ilizwi likaThixo baze baligcine.'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
